newsitem.title: CANADA: Russel gets dissident proxy circular.
newsitem.headline: Russel gets dissident proxy circular.

text.p: Russel Metals Inc said on Friday it has been informed that a shareholder has filed a dissident proxy circular nominating its own slate of directors for election at the company's annual and special meeting on May 14.

Russel said the shareholder that launched the dissident proxy is Paros Enterprises Ltd, the personal investment company of K. Rai Sahi and his spouse. Paros owns about 7.8 percent of the outstanding voting shares of Russel.

The company said in a statement that it will respond to the proxy in due course and that it does not believe that the Paros proposal to replace the entire board of Russel is in the best interests of the company and its shareholders.
"Our financial results indicate that the company's strategy is beginning to pay off and our earnings outlook is very positive," the company said.
